parts.title: January 2026
parts.html:
Days observed in January 2026

DateDayKey point
25 JanNational Voters' DayTheme 'My India, My Vote'; tagline 'Citizen at the heart of Indian democracy'
12 JanNational Youth DaySwami Vivekananda's birth anniversary; theme 'Ignite the Self, Impact the World'
23 JanParakram DiwasNetaji Subhas Chandra Bose's birth anniversary; observed since 2021
10 JanWorld Hindi DayTheme 'Hindi: From Traditional Knowledge to Artificial Intelligence'
15 JanIndian Army DayK.M. Cariappa became the first Indian Commander-in-Chief on 15 January 1949
24 JanInternational Day of EducationTheme 'The Power of Youth in Co-creating Education'
9 JanPravasi Bharatiya DivasHonours the Indian diaspora
19 JanNDRF Raising DayNational Disaster Response Force
16 JanNational Startup DayCelebrates India's start-up ecosystem
24 JanNational Girl Child DayAwareness on girls' rights and education
25 JanNational Tourism DayPromotes tourism in India
5 JanNational Bird DayBird conservation awareness
29 JanBeating RetreatEnds Republic Day celebrations at Vijay Chowk

Extra points

  • The first World Hindi Conference was held at Nagpur on 10 January 1975; World Hindi Day has been officially observed since 2006.
  • The Swami Vivekanand Chetna Mahotsav 2026 was held in Bilaspur (Chhattisgarh) for National Youth Day.
  • The 2026 Army Day parade was held in Rajasthan.
  • The UN has named 2026 the International Year of Rangelands and Pastoralists.
National Voters' Day: marks the founding of the Election Commission of India on 25 January 1950; first observed in 2011.
Pravasi Bharatiya Divas: 9 January recalls Mahatma Gandhi's return from South Africa in 1915; first held in 2003.
